idea-plugin.name: App Distribution for Firebase
idea-plugin.description:
Build a signed release APK and send it to your testers with Firebase App Distribution, without leaving Android Studio.

Features

  • One-click release build of your app module, using the same Gradle JDK as the IDE. Works with product flavors, custom APK names and projects that sign through Generate Signed App Bundle / APK (your keystore is remembered securely).
  • Distribute to testers with release notes. Recent testers are remembered per project.
  • Live progress with cancel, and a link to the release in the Firebase console.
  • Firebase CLI handled for you: uses your installed firebase, or downloads the standalone CLI (no Node.js needed). Sign in from the tool window.
  • Optional Slack announcements through an Incoming Webhook, with nicely formatted release notes.

Getting started

  1. Open the App Distribution tool window (right side).
  2. Install / sign in to Firebase CLI when prompted.
  3. Click Build Release APK, add testers and notes, then Distribute.

Your app needs a google-services.json for a Firebase project with App Distribution enabled.
